MOD_MP_ALLIANCE_PARALLEL_DESCRIPTION_CON: Create {alliance} with {guilds}. Both Guild Councils must approve.
MOD_MP_ALLIANCE_CONFIRM_FOUNDING: Both Guild Councils must approve the same Alliance name and founding pair. They can vote at the same time. Each Guild can consider only one Alliance affiliation at a time. Voting expires after 96 hours without a new ballot.
MOD_MP_ALLIANCE_CONFIRM_ADMISSION: Your Guild’s Council and the Alliance’s Member Guild Councils vote at the same time. Joining requires your Guild’s approval and a strict majority of existing Member Guilds. Your Guild does not count toward that majority. Voting expires after 96 hours without a new ballot.
MOD_MP_ALLIANCE_CONFIRM_COLLECTIVE: Every Member Guild’s Council votes at the same time. The proposal needs approval from a strict majority of Member Guilds; proposing it does not supply an automatic Aye or give your Guild a veto. Current policies remain in effect while voting. A membership change cancels unfinished proposals. Voting expires after 96 hours without a new ballot.
MOD_MP_ALLIANCE_CONFIRM_LEAVING: Leaving requires your Guild’s Council approval. Other Member Guilds do not need to approve. Leaving cancels unfinished Alliance proposals; an Alliance with fewer than two Guilds dissolves. Voting expires after 96 hours without a new ballot.
MOD_MP_ALLIANCE_CONFIRM_WITHDRAWAL: Withdrawing a submitted proposal requires your Guild’s Council approval. The original proposal can still be decided before the withdrawal passes. Voting expires after 96 hours without a new ballot.
MOD_MP_ALLIANCE_AFFILIATION_BLOCKED: Your Guild is already considering another Alliance affiliation. This proposal can wait until that process ends.
MOD_MP_ALLIANCE_AFFILIATION_PENDING: Your Guild is already considering an Alliance affiliation. Finish that process before starting another.
MOD_MP_ALLIANCE_POLICY_UNCHANGED: The current policy remains in effect until a change is approved.
MOD_MP_ALLIANCE_FOUNDING_COUNCILS: Both Guild Councils must approve; they can vote at the same time.
MOD_MP_ALLIANCE_FOUNDING_OTHER_COUNCIL: Our Council has approved. Awaiting the other Guild’s Council approval.
MOD_MP_ALLIANCE_AWAITING_APPLICANT_CONSE: The Alliance has approved. Awaiting the applicant Guild’s Council approval.
MOD_MP_ALLIANCE_CANCEL_ROSTER: Cancelled because the Alliance’s Member Guilds changed. A fresh proposal is required.

MOD_MP_ALLIANCE_CANCEL_ALLIANCE: Cancelled because the Alliance no longer exists.
